intro: Yemen is divided by war, with rival authorities controlling different parts of the country and the UN trying to broker peace.

chapters.title: Rival powers
text: The internationally recognised government, led by a Presidential Leadership Council, is based in Aden. The Houthis control Sanaa and much of the north-west, where most people live. Southern separatist groups have also held areas in the south at times.

chapters.title: The Red Sea
text: Since late 2023 Houthi attacks on ships in the Red Sea have disrupted world trade.

keyTerms.meaning: Someone who wants their region to become a separate country.
